item.title: Five key characteristics of AI agents and their impact on enterprise architecture (Source: www.leanix.net)
item.description: AI agents can pursue goals, adapt from experience, and carry out multi-step tasks across a variety of use cases. Five characteristics of agentic AI are especially relevant to enterprise architecture and should shape governance priorities to manage risk and capture the full benefits.

item.title: Architects Must Go Where Value Flows And Make Process Outcomes The Center Of EA (Source: www.forrester.com)
item.description: Customer journeys, value streams, and day-to-day processes are where value is created — or lost. Yet most enterprise architecture (EA) teams still optimize IT systems in isolation — disconnected from the business outcomes they’re meant to support. Find out how EA teams can pivot from system-centric to process-centric approaches.

item.title: Introducing the MCP server for SAP LeanIX solutions: Your gateway to connecting AI agents with enterprise architecture data (Source: www.leanix.net)
item.description: The MCP server for SAP LeanIX solutions is now available to all customers, making it easier than ever for enterprise architects to connect their AI agents to EA data. This new gateway removes the need to build custom connectors and helps you to reliably and securely implement agentic AI.

item.title: SAP announces AI agent hub and key industry partnerships (Source: www.leanix.net)
item.description: Today, we are thrilled to announce the launch of the AI agent hub capability in SAP LeanIX Application Portfolio Management, the premier enterprise architecture capability for discovering, managing, and governing AI agents and Model Context Protocol servers across the business. With the AI agent hub, companies gain a comprehensive overview of their AI agents. As a result, companies can inventory available agents, track agent performance, govern agent adoption, and guide strategic decisions around agentic AI.

item.title: Application total cost of ownership: Gain transparency, make informed decisions (Source: www.leanix.net)
item.description: SAP LeanIX adds application total cost of ownership (TCO) capabilities to capture application cost data, surface key cost drivers, and quantify rationalization opportunities. These capabilities can help enterprise architects bring cost transparency to their application portfolios and make faster, more data-backed decisions on application rationalization. Available today to all SAP LeanIX customers.
